title: Remote access entry (network range)
description: Expose this machine's DSH web GUI to a chosen network range (Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10 by default): only addresses inside the range are bound and peers outside it are refused, so you can reach it from a phone either with a tokenized URL or with a numeric access code. Remote pages can also use a phone layout, and the official UI preferences (appearance, font size, work details, coding view, performance & usage) can be stored in this plugin's config and applied to remote pages only.
